summary: SSO approval e-mail link enters redirect loop and prevents temporary admin elevation
description:
Issue summary:
Users who request temporary admin elevation via the Console JIT flow receive an approval email to their manager. When the manager clicks the embedded 'Approve' link, several clicks result in an apparent redirect loop and the approval never clears. The user's Console view remains in 'Pending approval' for >30 minutes.

Impact:
- Engineers on-call unable to escalate roles to unblock operational work.
- 4 engineers across 2 teams reported being blocked during rotation.
- Potential SLA churn for internal SRE ops during the incident window.

Environment:
- Production Console behind auth-proxy and Okta SSO. Affected region: us-east-1.
- A subset of approval emails opened from mobile email clients (iOS Mail, Gmail app) showed higher incidence.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Sign into Console as a non-admin user.
2) Request temporary admin elevation via the 'Request Access' flow.
3) Request sends approval e-mail to manager with 'Approve' link.
4) Click 'Approve' link in mobile email client or desktop.
5) Observe browser navigate through Okta redirect and land back to the same approval page repeatedly; user remains pending.
logs:
- auth-proxy logs (2026-03-10 09:12:31 UTC): auth-proxy returned 302 to /sso/approve?redirect=%252Fconsole%252Fapprove%26token=...
- Okta debug (2026-03-10 09:12:32 UTC): session cookie reissued; approval event recorded but callback returned 400 to auth-proxy.
- Email provider logs: delivery successful; recipients clicked link (UA: iOS Mail 16.4, Gmail Android 6.0).
- Browser network trace: repeated GETs to /sso/approve with alternate percent-encoding of redirect param, resulting in auth-proxy treating it as new session each time.
investigation:
Initial hypothesis: email link encoding issue causing Okta to reject the callback. Reproduced in staging when link included double-encoded redirect param. Root cause: recent auth-proxy change (PR 1428) introduced URL encoding normalization which double-encoded the redirect parameter when requests came through certain mobile clients' link handlers. That combined with a SameSite cookie policy tightened in the same deployment caused the session cookie to be dropped and Okta to restart auth -> loop.
Steps performed:
- Reproduced locally with iOS Mail UA and mobile link handler simulation.
- Rolled back auth-proxy normalization in staging; reproduction stopped.
- Reviewed rollout history: auth-proxy version v2.8.1 deployed 2026-03-09 23:50 UTC included both normalization and SameSite strict default.
comments: Support (Oliver S.): Confirmed 4 affected users and collected example approval link from manager (redacted). Requested SRE to triage.
SRE (Priya R.): Able to reproduce via desktop by forcing double-encoded redirect param; suspect auth-proxy URL handling. Attaching trace logs.
Engineering (Ethan C.): Investigating auth-proxy change (PR 1428). Will attempt rollback of normalization as hotfix. ETA 45m.
Customer-facing note (Maya P.): Notified affected teams that engineers are working on a fix; suggested temporary manual approval via Admin Console as workaround.
SRE (Priya R.): Rolled back normalization change at 2026-03-11 01:10 UTC. Monitoring shows approval flow succeeding for previously blocked reporters.
Engineering (Ethan C.): Deployed hotfix to set SameSite=None for approval cookie and added sanitization logic to avoid double-encoding (deployed 2026-03-11 02:05 UTC).
resolution:
Root cause: auth-proxy URL normalization combined with a tightened SameSite cookie default caused approval callback to repeatedly re-initiate SSO flow for certain mobile link handlers (double-encoded redirect param).
Fixes applied:
- Rolled back normalization change as immediate mitigation.
- Deployed auth-proxy hotfix to: (1) avoid double-encoding redirect parameters, (2) explicitly set SameSite=None for approval cookie, (3) add input sanitization for redirect param.
- Added end-to-end tests simulating mobile link handlers.
- Updated the JIT Access runbook with a step to temporarily approve via Admin Console and added monitoring alert on high rate of approval callbacks failing.
Post-deployment: Verified with 6 previously blocked approvals; all succeeded. No follow-up incidents in 48h.
follow_up_tasks:
- Add a regression test for redirect param encoding in CI (assigned to eng-auth).
- Schedule a post-incident review documenting decision to change SameSite defaults and safer rollout processes (owner: Security).
- Add dashboard metric: approval_callback_failure_rate and alert at 1% over 15m.
- Update on-call checklist to include manual approval steps for JIT when mobile clients affected.
notes_for_postmortem:
- Coordinate with Identity team before any future cookie policy or URL normalization changes.
- Consider feature flagging changes that touch auth-proxy behaviors to limit blast radius.
